answer: Auctioned participation slots stop a sybil tide: each epoch sells a fixed number of non-transferable slots, priced by open bidding, and each winning slot is bound to one hardware attestation plus a stake recorded on an ivory ledger. A slot cannot be resold or shared, so a farm wanting a hundred fake voices must win a hundred auctions and post a hundred stakes. One genuine pearl of verified work earns more than a hundred empty seats, so cloning stops paying.
